cat > /workspace/.build-logs/import_check.py <<'PYEOF'
import os, sys, glob
root = sys.argv[1]
# map service -> (venv python relative path, top-level import package candidates)
# We discover the package from src/ layout or the console-script module.
import re, json
results = {}
for d in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(root, "02-backend", "*"))):
    name = os.path.basename(d)
    df = os.path.join(d, "Dockerfile")
    if not os.path.isfile(df):
        continue
    txt = open(df).read()
    # find the main module from console script / uvicorn / venv bin
    # 1) [project.scripts] in pyproject
    mod = None
    py = os.path.join(d, "pyproject.toml")
    if os.path.isfile(py):
        ptxt = open(py).read()
        m = re.search(r'\[project\.scripts\]\s*\n\s*[\w-]+\s*=\s*"([\w\.]+):', ptxt)
        if m:
            mod = m.group(1).split(".")[0]
    # fallback: first dir under src/
    if not mod:
        srcs = [x for x in glob.glob(os.path.join(d, "src", "*")) if os.path.isdir(x)]
        srcs = [x for x in srcs if not os.path.basename(x).startswith(('.', '__'))]
        if srcs:
            # pick the one whose name matches service (dashes->underscores) or first
            base = name.replace("-", "_")
            mod = None
            for s in srcs:
                if os.path.basename(s).replace("-", "_") == base:
                    mod = os.path.basename(s)
            if not mod and srcs:
                mod = os.path.basename(srcs[0])
    results[name] = mod
print(json.dumps(results, indent=0))
PYEOF
docker run --rm -v /workspace:/w ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm python3 /w/.build-logs/import_check.py /w 2>&1 | grep -E '^\s*"' | head -40
